title: The counit-normalized tensor comparison of an exact flat-preserving functor
statement: Let C and D be braided closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. Use their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the signed direct-sum tensor on homotopy categories [lem-sfb-total-tensor-homotopy] and the native K-flat derived tensors [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal], built using K-flat complexes [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let F : C → D be additive, exact, a left adjoint and strong monoidal [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], and suppose F preserves flat objects. Write E = D(F), κ_P : E(Qh_C P) ≅ Qh_D(F_h P) for the exact-functor factorization, and δ(P,Q) : F_h(P ⊗ Q) → F_h P ⊗ F_h Q for the termwise oplax comparison. There exist isomorphisms e(K,L) : E(K ⊗ L) ≅ E(K) ⊗ E(L), natural in both derived objects, such that for every homotopy pair P,Q (without a K-flatness restriction) one has e(Qh P,Qh Q).hom ≫ (κ_P.hom ⊗ κ_Q.hom) ≫ μ(Qh_D)(F_h P,F_h Q) = E.map(μ(Qh_C)(P,Q)) ≫ κ_(P ⊗ Q).hom ≫ Qh_D.map(δ(P,Q)). The tensorators μ are the native lax tensorators of localization. No boundedness condition or compatibility of F with the braidings is required.

proof.text: The proved source-library Functor.leftDerivedTensorComparison uses functorial flat resolutions and is invertible componentwise when F preserves flat objects. Its tensor naturality and defining counit square are the source lemmas leftDerivedTensorComparison_naturality_tensorHom and leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_tensorHom. These use the native homotopy tensor and K-flat localization, not a replacement monoidal structure.

Let η : LF ≅ E be leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory, available since F is exact. Define e(K,L) = η(K ⊗ L) inverse, followed by the derived tensor comparison, followed by η(K) tensor η(L). To prove naturality, move η inverse through E(f tensor g), use tensor naturality of the source comparison, and then use η naturality on f and g.

For P,Q, precompose the asserted normalization equality by η at Qh(P) tensor Qh(Q), an isomorphism, and cancel η with its inverse. Combine the tensor products of maps. The factorization lemma leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_app_fac identifies each η followed by κ with the derived counit. Apply the defining counit square of the source tensor comparison. On the other side, naturality of η at μ(Qh_C)(P,Q), followed by the same factorization lemma, gives the identical composite. Cancel the precomposition to obtain the equation for all P,Q. The objectwise accessor is the corresponding component of this proved family.
